$comment: The daily production queue. brand-daily takes the next pending item each night, builds a reel and a video from it, and marks it done. Keep 5-10 items ahead so an overnight run never starves; when the queue is empty it falls back to 'evergreen' and says so in the review packet.

rules.$note: At the brand's 165 wpm: 15s ~= 38 words, 30s ~= 78 words, leaving room for the intro/outro bookends and breath. The runner enforces these so a script can never overrun its slot.
